title: E0026: Comment Ratio
plain_english: Reports classes whose comment ratio is below the configured minimum or above the configured maximum.
why_matters: Comments can provide useful context, but too few or too many can both be signals of maintenance problems. Very low comment coverage may leave intent unclear; very high comment coverage can indicate code that is hard to follow.
what_it_checks: Scans raw file lines and classifies them as code, comment, or blank.
